criterion: Quarantine files with a measured single-file run over 30 s, plus measured-red files whose assertions or waiting failures require repair before returning to the blocking suite.
source: Complete per-file run on box madarch-acc, 2026-11-18, /work/reports/01a1ef1e-9341-768e-9c66-eff98b21d199/results-passA.jsonl (379 records, the 0039 stack; seconds are taken for the 280 files that exist on worker/slow-split).
note: Each retained file has a concrete observed failure or passing slow behavior, a behavior-preserving rewrite plan and an explicit blocking-suite exit. Reasons distinguish assertion/setup defects from actual waiting timeouts; measured seconds remain from pass A, not the later rerun.
